snippet.title: Motor City - Official Trailer (2026) - Alan Ritchson, Shailene Woodley
snippet.description:
Powered by love, fueled by revenge. Experience Motor City showing at Regal July 24.

In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

Director: Potsy Ponciroli

Don't look away

Slow fire
Silver rain

Shadow Crown
Calling from beyond the veil

Shadow Crown

Floating through eternity

Shadow Crown
Shadow Crown
She still lives inside of me

Enjoy! 🎧

I am having the time of my life
And I wish that you were still right here.
I wish you came along.
You, why did you leave me so soon?
Before all the flowers could bloom?
I wish you came along.
And now that every day is a party,
Every night's a nightmare,
Wishing you came along.
Yes, I’m having the time of my life
But something about it feels so off.
I wish you came along.
If, if this is as good as it gets
Then why is my head such a mess, dear?
Oh, why is it all so wrong?
Cause now, that every day’s a party,
Every night's a nightmare.
I can’t let go in my head
Without wishing you came along.
I am having the time of my life
And I wish that you were still right here,
I wish you came along.
And I’ll be standing here like a stone,
Waves are crashing down years of passion.
How can the world keep moving on?
I will never let myself move on.
This isn’t real life; this isn’t over.
This isn’t real life; this isn’t over, dear.
It can’t be over, dear.

snippet.title: EsDeeKid - RockWave
snippet.description:
ROCKWAVE ///// WE JUST ALL DOGS AND RATS IN THE END ///// 

LYRICS: 

I walk through like nothing changed,
But I’m bossed up with some boss chains,
And I whip hard, cross lanes,
Breaking down all these top strains.

These Prada jeans got crop stains,
Gucci bag full of guap, mane,
First class on this NOC plane,
I’m the first kid on this RockWave.

I got purple haze like Hendrix,
The life that I live’s expensive,
Last week took a trip to the Emirates,
You ain’t getting that money that you lent us.

I just spent that on a rental,
Got the suicide doors, it’s mental,
Took a line, went straight to the temple,
I smoke grands and you still smoke menthol.

I got my Raf all damp from the champagne,
Beat that shit like Rampage,
I was offline, playing on campaign,
I’ve seen mad shit at a mad age.

I want a big yacht and a jet ski,
Cop a crown, I’m a king like Gretzky,
I’m on top, don’t care where the rest are,
I get anything ’cause I’m EsDee.

No father figure, no role model,
I don’t sip, I drink whole bottles,
Got a smart whip with a gold nozzle,
I’m smoking up in these chrome goggles.

I do it, I whip it, no crash, don’t kill it,
I got cars, I got money, I’ve got big stacks that I swim in,
I’m winning, I’m winning, two times, I’m with it,
Just walked up in that Gucci store, bought everything that was in it, ini.

A plan I drew up years ago

snippet.title: All You Need Is Love (Live from Abbey Road Studios, June 25th, 1967)
snippet.description:
The Beatles perform “All You Need Is Love” live for Our World — June 25, 1967 🌍

Broadcast to over 400 million people across 26 countries, Our World was the first ever live global satellite TV event. For the occasion, The Beatles performed ‘All You Need Is Love’ for the first time, capturing the spirit of the Summer of Love in a single moment seen around the world.

Filmed at Abbey Road Studios, the band performed live vocals over a pre-recorded backing track, surrounded by friends and fellow icons including Mick Jagger, Eric Clapton, Keith Richards, Keith Moon, and Marianne Faithfull.

This performance stands as one of the defining cultural moments of 1967 — a message of unity, broadcast across the globe.

Lyrics: 
Love, love, love.
Love, love, love.
Love, love, love.

There's nothing you can do that can't be done.
Nothing you can sing that can't be sung.
Nothing you can say but you can learn how to play the game.
It's easy.

Nothing you can make that can't be made.
No one you can save that can't be saved.
Nothing you can do, but you can learn how to be you in time.
It's easy

All you need is love.
All you need is love.
All you need is love, love.
Love is all you need.

All you need is love.

All you need is love, love.
Love is all you need.

There's nothing you can know that isn't known.

Nowhere you can be that isn't where you're meant to be. It's easy

Love is all you need...

🔥Play War Thunder for FREE and get a massive bonus pack! PC, PlayStation and Xbox —  https://wtplay.link/thebacklogs 💥

Last time we attempted this, we got the run all the way to Sens Fortress before we were no longer able to progress. We covered a lot of side paths, but the main questline was unobtainable.
...or so I thought.
But after challenging the Dark Souls community to do better, we can now say with absolute certainty that Dark Souls 1 can be completely beaten without every aggoing an enemy.

Collect a cast of charming Monsters with a passion for song in the award-winning My Singing Monsters! Download for free: https://bigbl.be/PlayMySingingMonsters
Breed and feed hundreds of quirky musical Monsters with their own unique sounds to form a furry and feathery orchestra. Then place your Monsters on beautifully decorated and fully-customizable Islands to create catchy tunes that you’ll be singing along to in no time! With so many Monsters to collect, you’ll be addicted to this monstrously fun game before you know it.

FEATURES:
• Over 400 unique monsters to collect, nurture, and love
• Amazing art, animation, and audio effects
• Lush islands, each with its own musical theme
• Dozens of wacky decorations and structures
• Built-in social features and activities
• New and exciting content is always in the works!

The unique musical world of My Singing Monsters would not be possible without the hard work and dedication of the Monster-Handler Team. From the fantastical designs provided by Art and Animation, to the iconic sounds and scores from the Audio Team, this musical menagerie is built on the shared work of many. Special thanks to the design, production & programming teams, marketing & promotions, testing & support, and to everyone Big Blue Bubble who make My Singing Monsters possible.
